test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the setting in which the numbers are related in the same way as the numbers of the following set.

(11, 8, 33)

(33, 5, 924)

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed)
solution:
**Explanation : **

(11, 8, 33) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40fed0c713ca4a3cf0bcc6f10815bbf55457ea225f1f9fb8a8ca0f0c8b379a8e.png] 

 
• 11 - 8 = 3
 
• 3 * 11( first number )
 
• = 33

(33, 5, 924) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40fed0c713ca4a3cf0bcc6f10815bbf55457ea225f1f9fb8a8ca0f0c8b379a8e.png] 

 
• 33 - 5 = 28
 
• 28 * 33 ( first number )
 
• = 924

Similarly,

Option 2 follows the pattern

(**24, 15, 216) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40fed0c713ca4a3cf0bcc6f10815bbf55457ea225f1f9fb8a8ca0f0c8b379a8e.png] **

 
• **24 - 15 = 9**
 
• **9 * 24 ( first number )**
 
• **= 216**

** **Hence,** (24, 15, 216)** is the correct answer.
